description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for configuring HTML form elements, including form attributes and input fields.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the form dialog by retrieving the current form element from the selection.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates or inserts a form element into the editor based on dialog input.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Initializes form attribute setup functions for dialog content elements.
